detector.name: (K8s health) K8s node cpu > 95% for 5 min
detector.programText:
AB = alerts(detector_name='(k8s health) K8s node cpu above 95%').publish(label='AB')
AD = alerts(detector_name='(k8s health) K8s node cpu > 95% for 5 min').publish(label='AD')
A = data('k8s.node.cpu.usage').mean(by=['k8s.node.name']).publish(label='A')
detect(when(A > threshold(95), lasting='5m', at_least=0.8), auto_resolve_after='15d').publish('(k8s health) K8s node cpu > 95% for 5 min')

rules.description: The value of k8s.node.cpu.usage - Mean by k8s.node.name is above 95 for 80% of 5m.
rules.detectLabel: (k8s health) K8s node cpu > 95% for 5 min
